title: eBay Gift Cards Have Been Delisted - Are There Any Deals Left?
body:
I was hoping that I would be able to use gift cards as I usually do for a bit of a discount on an almost $600 purchase, only to discover that gift cards for eBay have been delisted. Are there any deals on them still remaining?
I tried all the codes too on the OzBargain ebay page but none are working for this either (USA purchase).
Can anyone suggest any way to still get a discount (besides cashback - I'll try TopCashback).
Thank you
